verdict.rationale: First-party self-hosting docs say Skyvern runs entirely on your own infrastructure, with your own servers, browsers and LLM keys (skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-2). They document pip, Docker Compose and Kubernetes deployment with local-model support (skyvern-docs-42). The open-source GitHub repo and the AGPL3 licensing a community member notes corroborate that the core is available to self-host (skyvern-gh-1, skyvern-comm-3, skyvern-probe-1). Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of running a self-hosted deployment, and clarity on whether cloud-only features (e.g. Cloud UI builder, proxies) are included in the self-hosted version.
